name: GEOG 1070E
title: Natural Disasters and Environmental Change
description: (Also offered as ERTH 1070E.) Climate change, global warming, natural hazards, earth surface processes, and the impact these have on human populations now and in the past. Students who complete both ERTH 1070 and ERTH 1052 may request that ERTH 1070 be converted to a CA 3 Laboratory course. CA 3.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed ERTH 1010, 1050, 1051, 1055.
